description: ARC Agent Shopping Index pilot results (pilot, not a ranking): whether 3 models, run as benchmark personas via OpenRouter (not the consumer apps), reached a checkout step on their own on 35 non-Shopify stores, stopped before payment, with no accounts. Two runs: per model, hand-verified checkouts pooled over both runs with Wilson 95% intervals, the per-run counts side by side, the run-to-run flip count and each run's review agreement; plus each run's full data (cart or better, blocks, median steps and time, cost per checkout, every store × model outcome). One reviewer, and the pooled intervals overlap for every model pair. Returns {"status":"draft"} until the pilot is published. Reads only.
name: get_benchmark
